details.question: Top 3 products in the West by revenue for 2025
details.sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND r.region_name = 'West' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

details.question: How much budget did the East have for 2025?
details.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT c.region_id, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY c.region_id), b AS (SELECT region_id, SUM(revenue_budget) AS bud FROM budgets WHERE substr(month, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY region_id) SELECT r.region_name, ROUND(a.rev, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(b.bud, 2) AS budget, ROUND(a.rev - b.bud, 2) AS variance FROM regions r JOIN a ON a.region_id = r.region_id JOIN b ON b.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.region_name = 'East' ORDER BY variance
